title: Unlearning by Extrapolating a Shrink-and-Heal Lookahead
abstract: arXiv:2611.00374v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Unlearning aims to make a large language model behave like one retrained without its forget set. Prevailing likelihood-suppression objectives, however, lack an explicit forgetting target: they continually reward lower forget-set likelihood, making forgetting sensitive to the optimization budget. We address this limitation by estimating the direction toward the oracle without training it. Our key idea is to shrink the fine-tuned model toward its pre-fine-tuning weights and briefly re-learn the retain set, thereby removing the forget-specific contribution; in the linearized regime, this shrink-and-heal lookahead moves the model a fixed fraction of the way to the retrained model, its unique fixed point. Our method, SHIFT, extrapolates the lookahead's per-token changes into distillation targets and iteratively refines them. translated_title: 通过外推“收缩-修复”前瞻实现机器遗忘
translated_abstract: 机器遗忘旨在使大语言模型表现得像在没有遗忘集的情况下重新训练过的模型。然而，主流的似然抑制目标缺乏明确的遗忘目标：它们持续追求更低的遗忘集似然，使得遗忘效果对优化预算非常敏感。我们通过在不实际训练“重训模型”的情况下估计其方向来解决这一限制。我们的核心思想是将微调后的模型向其微调前的权重收缩，并短暂地重新学习保留集，从而去除与遗忘相关的特定贡献；在线性化条件下，这种“收缩-修复”前瞻会将模型移动到重训模型（其唯一不动点）方向上固定比例的距离。我们的方法SHIFT将前瞻的逐token变化外推为蒸馏目标，并进行迭代细化。在统一的OpenUnlearning协议下与十一个基线方法进行对比评估，SHIFT取得了最高的综合得分。
tldr: SHIFT方法通过将微调模型向微调前权重收缩并重新学习保留集来估计通往重训模型的方向，再将该前瞻过程的逐token变化外推为蒸馏目标并迭代优化，实现了最先进的机器遗忘效果。
en_tdlr: SHIFT estimates the direction toward the retrained model by shrinking the fine-tuned model toward its pre-fine-tuning weights and re-learning the retain set, then extrapolates the lookahead's per-token changes into distillation targets with iterative refinement, achieving state-of-the-art unlearning performance.
